Centro storico e Veronetta — Verona, Italy

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

The Arena, Piazza Bra, via Mazzini and Ponte Pietra — where essentially every visitor to Verona spends their time — and, across the Adige, Veronetta. Those two sit in the same circoscrizione and are not the same place. The tourist core is calm at any hour it is worth being out in. Veronetta is a university district that local reporting describes as a structured drug market rather than an occasional one, drawing buyers from outside the city, with piazza Santa Toscana and the streets around it named as the focal point; residents went public about it in August 2026. The Giardini Baden Powell, at the southern edge of the centre, are inside the Prefettura's designated zone rosse. Walk the core freely; treat upper Veronetta after dark the way you would any dealing spot.
